background: PhD Mathematics (Statistics and Probability), University of Bath, October 2025 to present. EPSRC-funded in the SAMBa Centre for Doctoral Training. Expected completion November 2029.
MMath Mathematics, First Class Honours (79%), University of Bath, 2020 to 2025. Marks of 85 to 97 in probability and statistics modules.

cdt: Training in the SAMBa CDT covers advanced probability, statistics, machine learning, numerical analysis and mathematical modelling, including numerical methods for PDEs. I achieved 91% in Numerical Solution of Evolutionary Equations.
